gates.reason: Recommendation fields are rendered through React text nodes, with no raw HTML, command execution, secret egress, or client-controlled URL construction.
The component preserves recommendation fields, uses the canonical evidence target for navigation, and does not construct or validate recommendation evidence, savings, or fix snippets.
Rendering is bounded to one recommendation and performs only constant-size formatting and evidence-target derivation.
Projects, models, session identifiers, and labels are rendered as escaped React content; no raw HTML, credential egress, injection sink, or privileged operation is present.

Displayed totals, absolute deltas, directions, and percentages consistently derive from the supplied breakdown fields; non-finite percentage cases are explicitly represented as 0% or new, and week dates are shown.
The potentially expensive breakdown is memoized over its inputs, initial row/session rendering is capped, and full lists render only after explicit user expansion.
This module only deterministically serializes and hashes in-memory block values for UI keys; it performs no rendering, I/O, authentication, egress, or privileged operation.
It neither detects, parses, calculates, nor presents recommendation claims or validated fix snippets.
Key generation traverses each block input once, sorts object keys for stability, handles cycles, and uses one pass to disambiguate duplicate keys.
This pure chart-series transformation performs no rendering sink, I/O, authentication, secret handling, command execution, or privileged operation.
Daily points preserve dates, rounded costs, and entry counts; weekly points use reproducible Monday-start UTC buckets and correctly sum costs and entries while retaining the observed date extent.
Series construction is linear apart from sorting weekly buckets, and histories over 90 active days are downsampled for the all-time surface.
